envelope.description: Refuse request-carrying calls to a daemon without the capability

body.title: Refuse request-carrying calls to a daemon without the capability
body.summary: In src/mcp/forward-step.ts, reuse the existing daemon.status request and the DaemonStatus type from t15 (no new RPC) to read features before forwarding a call that carries a request object to insrc_analyze_step or insrc_analyze, on a fresh connection per call, and throw DaemonTooOldError when 'analyze-request' is absent; prompt-only calls are always forwarded.
acceptanceChecks: a request call to a daemon without the feature is refused with DaemonTooOldError
a prompt-only call is forwarded to any daemon
a same-process reconnect test that switches daemon capability between calls sees the change

tests.name: forward-step-features.test.ts: a request call to a daemon lacking analyze-request is refused with DaemonTooOldError, forwarded to a daemon that advertises it, a prompt-only call is forwarded to either, and a same-process reconnect that switches daemon capability between calls sees the change
